title: Adult with rising alcohol intake
goal: You are the clinician. Screen an adult's alcohol use without judgment: cover quantity, frequency, impact, withdrawal safety, and readiness to change, then confirm next steps.
opening: I have been having a few drinks most nights to unwind. My partner thinks it is becoming a problem.

disclosures.response: Most nights it is three or four drinks. On weekends it can be more, maybe six or seven.
It is every day now, mostly. I used to keep it to weekends.
I have missed a couple of mornings of work, and my partner and I argue about it most weeks.
If I go a day without drinking, I get shaky and a little nauseous by the afternoon.
I have driven after drinking a few times. I tell myself I am fine, but I know it was not smart.
Part of me wants to cut down, but I am not sure I can do it on my own.
I tried stopping once on my own and lasted about a month before it crept back.

metrics.name: Introduction and consent
metrics.rationale: Introduces self and sets a non-judgmental tone.
metrics.coaching_hint: Introduce yourself and ask permission before the screening.

metrics.name: Quantity and frequency
metrics.rationale: Quantifies drinks per occasion and days per week.
metrics.coaching_hint: Quantify use: 'How many drinks on a typical day, and how many days a week?'

metrics.name: Impact on life
metrics.rationale: Explores consequences for work, relationships, and daily life.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask about impact: 'How has drinking affected your work, relationships, or health?'

metrics.name: Withdrawal and safety
metrics.rationale: Screens for withdrawal symptoms and safety risks such as driving after drinking.
metrics.coaching_hint: Screen for withdrawal and safety: 'Any shaking or nausea when you stop, or driving after drinking?'

metrics.name: Readiness and next step
metrics.rationale: Explores readiness to change and prior attempts, then agrees on a next step.
metrics.coaching_hint: Explore readiness: 'What would you want to change, and what has worked or not worked before?'

metrics.name: Shared next-step confirmation
metrics.rationale: Confirms the next step and checks understanding.
metrics.coaching_hint: Confirm the next step and check understanding before ending.
